project_type: Rust/egui desktop workspace (FileForgeWorkbench, ff-desktop binary + many ff-* library crates); ISPF-style workbench
language: Rust (edition 2021), egui/eframe GUI, headless egui_kittest tests
build_system: Cargo workspace. Custom xtask-style gate aliases (cargo gate / cargo full-gate). Per-crate scoped commands via -p <crate>.
test_framework: Rust built-in test + egui_kittest (build_eframe headless full-shell harness) + pretty_assertions. Full suite via cargo nextest / cargo gate (OWNER-ONLY runs).
test_command: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p <crate> <test_name>"  (SCOPED only; agents never run the full suite)
verification_instructions: gate-policy.md + testing.md EXECUTION SPLIT: an agent proves the change COMPILES CLEAN and is lint/format clean using SCOPED bounded commands and reads their output: cargo check -p <crate>, cargo clippy -p <crate> -- -D warnings, cargo fmt -p <crate> -- --check, plus the SCOPED new unit tests where quick (cargo test -p <crate> <name>). Agents MUST NOT run cargo test (whole), cargo nextest, cargo gate, or cargo full-gate -- the OWNER runs the full gate + suite MANUALLY outside Kiro. TDD unchanged: write the failing test first, implement, run it SCOPED. Terminal discipline (terminal-discipline.md): run via the clean pwsh7 wrapper (C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "..."); one command per invocation, NEVER a ';'-chained line (guard hard-blocks it when the proxy is off); when the execution proxy fires, read the result file it names; verify by EFFECT (read the log/result file), never trust the reported Exit Code. STOP before merge: no merge, no push.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. Box-drawing rendered-frame fixtures are test literals, not generated checked-in files.
environment_constraints: Work INSIDE the worktree c:/workspace/apps/FileForgeWorkbench/.worktrees/common-frame-impl; relative paths from elsewhere land in the parent workspace. Use git -C <worktree> for git. The integrated terminal mangles/swallows output; an execution proxy may run commands and write result files under C:\Users\A142367\.kiro\terminal-log\results\ -- read those. grep_search / file_search only see the MAIN workspace, NOT the worktree tree; use read_file with absolute worktree paths and the glob/file_search that DID resolve worktree paths (file_search matched worktree paths in exploration). No source .rs file over 400 non-test lines; split a test file before ~200 lines. ASCII-only in docs and pattern-matched source; box-drawing glyphs allowed ONLY inside rendered-frame fixtures/tests.
contribution_requirements: framework-conformance.md: NO framework change -- build ON ScreenProvider/ScreenModel, shell chrome, WorkspaceContext, Kind registry, render_status.rs; do NOT reshape public types (WorkspaceContext/InteriorFocus/WorkspaceDescriptor/ScreenModel/Table). Message_Line + last_action_at are ADDITIVE shell state (owner-confirmed). Resolver (shell/environment.rs) UNTOUCHED. Preserve the single render_workspace_context focus latch, ISPF explicit-commit save (save-convention.md), single command dispatch, and the stable egui ids the full-shell tests depend on (command_field_input etc.). testing.md: every test carries a // Validates: Requirement 7.x / 30.x annotation; name the behaviour; deterministic. rust-standards.md: thiserror/anyhow, no unwrap in lib code, 400-line file rule.
key_patterns: Per-Context ScreenModel builders live in shell/screen_providers*.rs (each returns ff_screen_model::ScreenModel from live logical state, never egui). The single snapshot/capture dispatch seam is shell/screen_provider.rs::active_screen_capture (SNAPSHOT + CAPTURE share it). The renderer is ff-screen-model/src/render/{text,html,ansi,markdown,yaml}.rs; ScreenModel (ff-screen-model/src/model.rs) already has header_lines/body_lines/footer_lines/tables/status_bar/command_line slots. The per-action dispatch seams are shell/commands_line.rs::begin_command_line (typed + key paths) and shell/target_dispatch.rs::dispatch_bound_command (menu clicks). Status bar + key bar render in shell/render_status.rs; panel order set in shell/update.rs (render_key_label_bar then render_status_bar; egui bottom panels stack upward in call order, so add the message-line panel AFTER render_status_bar to sit above it). The one live window title is const "FileForge Workbench" in main.rs. Full-shell tests use harness_shell() + cmd_field_id() from shell/tests_common.rs; mirror tests_config_snapshot_fidelity.rs for snapshot tests and full_shell_alias_editor_is_single_chrome for single-chrome guards.
relevant_files: crates/ff-desktop/src/screen_snapshot.rs (menu_workspace_screen_model_full, MenuScreenChrome; the one title const location)
docs/specs/workspace-framework/{requirements.md Req 7, design.md Sec 11, tasks.md Phase CF}
directory_structure: crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/ holds the WorkbenchShell (split across many files for the 400-line rule: state, construct, actions, commands*, dispatch, target_dispatch, render*, screen_provider*, tests_*). crates/ff-desktop/src/ holds panels (alias_editor_panel/, config_panel, theme_editor_panel), screen_snapshot.rs, main.rs. crates/ff-screen-model/ is the GUI-independent capture engine (model.rs + render/ submodules). docs/specs/<sub-project>/ holds requirements/design/tasks. .kiro/steering/ holds the rules. IMPORTANT SCOPE FINDING: Phase 2G of screen-snapshot-scrm (Req 29 CR-CH-115, the 'shared chrome helper' Phase 2H extends) is NOT implemented on this branch -- non-menu *_screen_model builders add no window/menu/tab/status chrome, and render/text.rs renders tables via row.join("  ") with no box-drawing grid.
